name: Open Invite Rush
hook: An open wedding invite brings 30,000 uninvited guests to your backyard
tagline: Watch a peaceful backyard ceremony get mobbed by thousands of strangers dumping live goats, toaster ovens, and used sedans onto the gift table. Cash out early to flee the reception in a getaway golf cart with your wedding cake intact. If you crash, thirty thousand hungry party crashers crush the marquee and initiate an uncontrollable conga line.
